data.summary: This week Ethan Qiu made 16 GitHub contribution counts and 15 pushes across public repositories including UTMIST/Misty, Jeff15321/mathify-brief, UTMIST/UTMIST, and SomethingObvious/Valorant-Overseer. He opened pull requests in Jeff15321/mathify-brief (#6-#14), SomethingObvious/Valorant-Overseer (#1-#2), UTMIST/Misty (#378, #379, #380, #386), and UTMIST/UTMIST (#505, #507-#510, #518). He also reviewed UTMIST/Misty#385 and opened issues in UTMIST/Misty (#383, #384) and UTMIST/UTMIST (#504, #506).
